_comment: Word pool for the auto-suggested name on the landing page. Edit freely and refresh the page — the server re-reads this file on every request, so no rebuild and no restart. A name is one adjective plus one name. Empty or malformed lists fall back to the built-in pool in apps/server/src/names.ts. Keep pairings under 32 characters (MAX_NAME_CHARS) or the server will reject the suggestion.
